Action Plan:
1. Start the prescribed NSAID similar to ibuprofen (name/dose/route/frequency not documented), to be taken regularly with food; do not take concurrently with ibuprofen.
2. May take acetaminophen (paracetamol) in addition as needed for pain, as advised.
3. Supportive care: rest and maintain good hydration.
4. Safety net: seek medical attention if headache worsens, new symptoms develop (fever, rash, vomiting, neck stiffness), or if similar episodes recur.
5. Follow-up: if not improving within 1–2 days after starting the prescribed medication, contact the clinic for reassessment.
6. Verbal consent from patient has been obtained before using transcription software.

Assessment & Plan:
